description: This file defines the IterateSectionWidget class, a Java class that extends ModelScreenWidget. It is part of the OFBiz framework's widget model, responsible for handling iteration over list data in screen widgets, including support for pagination, rendering sections, and managing context for UI rendering.

classes.name: IterateSectionWidget
classes.description: A widget class used to iterate over a list within the screen framework, including support for pagination and dynamic rendering of sections based on data collection.

methods.name: getSectionList
methods.description: Returns the list of section objects that this widget manages.

methods.name: renderWidgetString
methods.description: Renders the widget's content into the provided Appendable, handling iteration over list items, context setup, and pagination controls.

methods.name: getPaginateTarget
methods.description: Returns the target for pagination actions based on expanded context.

methods.name: getPaginate
methods.description: Determines whether pagination is enabled based on expanded context and widget attribute.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the configured view size for pagination.

methods.name: renderNextPrev
methods.description: Renders the pagination navigation controls (Next/Previous links) into the output writer.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Allows a visitor pattern to process this widget.

methods.name: getListNameExdr
methods.description: Returns the flexible map accessor for the list name.

methods.name: getEntryNameExdr
methods.description: Returns the flexible string expander for list entry name.

methods.name: getKeyNameExdr
methods.description: Returns the flexible string expander for list key name.

methods.name: getPaginateTarget
methods.description: Returns the flexible string expander for paginate target.

methods.name: getPaginate
methods.description: Returns the flexible string expander for whether pagination is enabled.
